description: Searches Praetorium’s missions, force dispositions, deployments, terrain, rules, detachments, and datasheets by name, number, keyword, and value, then datasheets and detachments whose abilities, stratagems or enhancements say the words searched for, such as objective control remains for an ability that keeps an objective. Returns bounded excerpts with canonical URLs, source revisions, and attribution; a match found by what an ability says names that ability and points at its section. Rules text is not included; records point to it upstream.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

query.description: A name, a printed rule number, an ability, a weapon, or a keyword.

name: search_reference

textSources.description: Where withheld rules text lives upstream: the pinned file, its source, and the id of the record holding it there when the file has one. Fetch it there if you need the wording.

title: Search the Praetorium game reference
